description: This file contains core logic functions for a Tic-Tac-Toe game, including checking for a winner, detecting draws, parsing and serializing boards, and applying moves.

methods.name: Optional[str] check_winner(board: List[List[Optional[str]]])
methods.description: Checks the game board for a winner ('X' or 'O') and returns the symbol if found, otherwise None.

methods.name: bool is_draw(board: List[List[Optional[str]]])
methods.description: Determines if the game is a draw, meaning the board is full and there is no winner.

methods.name: List[List[Optional[str]]] parse_board(board_str: str)
methods.description: Converts a string representation of the board into a 3x3 matrix with optional strings ('X', 'O', or None).

methods.name: str serialize_board(board: List[List[Optional[str]]])
methods.description: Converts a 3x3 matrix back into a string representation, using '_' for empty cells.

methods.name: Tuple[bool,str] apply_move(board: List[List[Optional[str]]], row: int, col: int, symbol: str)
methods.description: Attempts to place a symbol ('X' or 'O') on the board at specified row and column, returning success status and message.

ctags.name: apply_move
ctags.pattern: /^def apply_move(board: List[List[Optional[str]]], row: int, col: int, symbol: str) -> Tuple[bool,/
ctags.signature: (board: List[List[Optional[str]]], row: int, col: int, symbol: str)
